title: Music Row 2BR, 3 Beds | Free Gated Parking
description:
Stay in the heart of Music Row in this spacious 2BR/2BA condo for up to six guests. With one king bed, two queen beds, complimentary gated parking and a quiet private patio, everyone can relax just minutes from Broadway, Vanderbilt, Belmont and The Gulch. Enjoy a bright living area, fully equipped kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, hotel-style essentials, plus access to the shared rooftop lounge, fitness center and seasonal pool. Ideal for couples, families, friends and Vanderbilt visits.

The space
Welcome to your bright, thoughtfully designed Nashville, home base on iconic Music Row. This 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo sleeps 6 and blends hotel-style comfort with the ease of a full home—perfect for couples, friends, families, or a weekend in Music City.

Inside, you’ll find a fully equipped kitchen stocked beyond the basics (pots and pans, wine glasses, tea kettle, coffee maker, plus a selection of coffees, teas, and spices). Bedroom 1 features a cozy king bed, while Bedroom 2 offers two queen beds so everyone can spread out. End the day with a glass of wine on the quiet private patio—a calm pause between Broadway nights and Nashville adventures.

Building amenities at The Crescendo (Music Row):
Enjoy gated, secure parking, a fitness room (treadmills, ellipticals, free weights), a private conference/meeting room, and a rooftop clubroom with skyline views, entertaining kitchen, gathering spaces, billiards table, and a sprawling rooftop patio. The seasonal pool with baja ledge and pool bar area is currently closed through May 2026.

🛏 Sleeping Arrangements
BEDROOM 1: 1 KING BED WITH JACK-AND-JILL BATHROOM
BEDROOM 2: 2 QUEEN BEDS WITH ENSUITE BATHROOM

☕ Amenities included in your stay
In every Humming Host home, you will find an elevated essentials setup, including a coffee bar with locally sourced coffee, basic kitchen staples (olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt and pepper), hand soap, dish soap, and body wash/conditioner/shampoo dispensers, ample paper goods and trash bags, and laundry and dishwasher pods. 

⭐ About Humming Host
Humming Host is a local, boutique property management company curating beautiful homes in prime locations for sustainable, unforgettable stays.
At the heart of how we operate is our Thoughtful Stay Program — a collection of intentional decisions, some visible to guests and some behind the scenes, that come together to create a stay that feels genuinely looked after. The program focuses on six key areas: local sourcing, waste reduction, sustainable amenities, community giveback, curated local culture, and guest convenience.
We implement these standards across every property we manage as part of our commitment to thoughtful hospitality. Our local hosting team ensures each home is fully prepared before arrival, and our guest services team is available daily from 7:00 AM–11:00 PM CST to support you before, during, and after your stay.

📍 About The Crescendo
The Crescendo is a luxury condo building on iconic Music Row, blending a boutique feel with elevated, hotel-style amenities. Guests enjoy amazing amenities:
★ On-site concierge and overnight security
★ Rooftop lounge with pool table and outdoor seating
★  Meeting room
★  Seasonal pool 
★  Fitness center open 24/7
★ Complimentary on-site parking and convenient luggage storage. 

All of this is just minutes from Broadway and close to Vanderbilt and Belmont—walkable to cafés, shops, and restaurants, yet tucked into a quieter pocket of town.

★★ Exclusive Guest Perks★★
As a guest, you’ll have access to exclusive perks and promotions with select local Nashville businesses and experiences through Humminghost's partnerships. Offers may vary, so reach out to us for current details and redemption information.

Guest access
Check-in is simple with smart locks. Before your arrival, we’ll send detailed instructions with your door codes, directions to the unit, and any access info for shared amenities or parking. Please review these notes ahead of time to ensure a smooth arrival.

Other things to note
★Possible Daytime Noise from Nearby Construction★
Please note that there is an active construction project in the surrounding area. Work typically takes place during standard daytime hours (approximately 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday), and you may experience some intermittent noise during this time. While this is outside of our control, we want to ensure full transparency so you can plan accordingly. Evenings, nights, and weekends are generally quiet.

★Amenities & Building Facilities★
Guests have access to the building’s shared amenities and common areas. While we promptly notify the HOA or building management of any issues, we do not control the cleanliness, maintenance, repair, or availability of these shared spaces and cannot guarantee specific amenities will be available at all times.

★Smoke-Free Home & Community★
In accordance with building rules, smoking is not permitted inside the unit or any common areas. Guests who violate this policy may be subject to fines or removal per HOA regulations.

★Supplies & Essentials★
We provide a generous starter supply of essentials, including trash bags, toilet paper (at least two rolls per bathroom), and a full roll of paper towels. If you run out during your stay or require more than what is provided, you are welcome to purchase additional items as needed.

★Families & Baby Gear★
Traveling with little ones? A pack-n-play and baby gate (in homes with stairs) available upon request, subject to availability. Please message your host in advance if you would like a baby package prepared for your stay.

★Maintenance & Repairs★	
Each property is thoroughly inspected before arrival to ensure systems and appliances are functioning properly. If you experience any maintenance issue during your stay, please contact your host as soon as possible. We will always do our best to resolve it promptly; however, repair timelines may depend on vendor and contractor availability.
 
★Building Access & Trash Rooms★ 
The lobby and mail room are located on ground level, with all units situated on the floors above the lobby. Guests can access the units via stairs or elevator. A trash room is available on every unit level and located next to the elevators on the left-hand side for convenient waste disposal during your stay.

★Luggage Storage★
Complimentary luggage storage is available in the Crescendo Mail Room, located in the lobby. Storage is provided on a first-come, first-served basis. Please note that this area is accessible to all guests, owners, and mail carriers. We are not responsible for any lost or stolen items.
